edit: Adapt this existing red-roof wooden barn into a cattle barn with a modest structural upgrade. Wooden wall framing rests visibly on the stone plinth. Widen the central cattle entrance slightly, with thick timber lintel and sturdy doorposts anchored into stone; open dark interior, a little straw inside. Stone threshold remains nearly at ground level, no steep stairs for cattle. Add discreet reinforcing timber braces and a small carved cow-head emblem below the loft. Polish tile readability and rich warm brown wood to match cozy farming RPG sprites, compact pixel clusters and crisp dark colored outlines. Straight-on, front-facing 2D game view, horizontal front facade, roof visible from slightly above; no isometric, diagonal or three-quarter side view. Preserve complete silhouette, transparent background, no text or surrounding scenery.
